unspecified_scores.reason: Only a query with free text and an exclusion triggers it, and the user sees nothing different. Every caller (useVideoApp.ts:226, useNotesTarget.ts:84, and Reading through its member resolver) tries resolveMemberTarget first, and a query with free text always becomes a member target (memberTarget.ts:89), so the new direct params with search and exclude keys are never sent. The change only alters the result of a usability check whose outcome was already usable.

It applies when a Video target query excludes a kind and the folder has a fixed file_type. The user sees no difference: resolveVideoTarget re-resolves kinds with folder.file_type at videoAppTarget.ts:57-61 and returns empty whenever the fixed kind is not video or video is excluded, so leaving out the argument at line 54 never changes the result.

specification_compliance: All three touch-point findings are confirmed: two new test files and one rewritten existing test sit outside the declared touch-point list. They are test-only files and do not change product behavior.
regression_risks: resolveAppTarget now returns usable params for free-text queries that hold exclusions. Any future caller that consults it before resolveMemberTarget would send search plus exclude keys directly instead of evaluating members.
test_coverage: readingAppTarget.test.ts:94-107 pins direct exclude_tag carriage, and pins that a '!type:pdf' spelling is treated as search text and becomes a member target.
